quarantined_artifacts.reason: Synthetic self-composed HTML files lacking HTTP status/headers, canonical provenance, and containing out-of-scope geographic targets (Hanoi, HCMC).

detailed_findings.synthetic_raw_defect: The HTML payloads were self-composed without HTTP response metadata, status codes, server headers, or verifiable remote HTTP capture provenance.
detailed_findings.out_of_scope_defect: Targets included local transit systems for Hanoi (Transerco) and HCMC (MAUR Metro 1), which violate the Da Nang student ecosystem scope.
detailed_findings.mitigation: Micro-Batch 01 is permanently isolated. No closure ledger will be produced. Micro-Batch 02 will enforce strict Da Nang geographic scope and full HTTP capture receipts.
